highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 adopts Skia m157 with native rendering fixes and explicit source-generated interop calling conventions.
highlights_body: The managed API surface remains unchanged. Native updates address clipped paths, glyph replay, Graphite readback and Vulkan initialization.

breaking.title: Check Graphite Metal runtime targets
breaking.body: Graphite Metal adopts a native runtime minimum of iOS/tvOS 15; its macOS minimum remains 12. If using this backend, target a supported OS version. These backend minimums do not lower any higher requirements imposed by managed packages or frameworks.

bullets.detail: Updates the native renderer to milestone 157 while preserving the existing glyph-bounds guard and managed API. The HarfBuzzSharp package revision becomes 14.4.0.200; the native shaping engine remains HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

Fixes convex anti-aliased path buffer overflow across vertical clip gaps, coverage-mask clamping and device-space path bounds. Corrects Graphite clip keys and wedge bounds, and validates direct-mask Slug data and unsupported fractional glyph replay.
Corrects Graphite alpha-to-RGBx GPU-to-CPU transfer stride and initializes Vulkan render-pass pointers correctly.

Makes LibraryImport declarations use the same cdecl convention as existing DllImport and delegate paths, correcting an ABI mismatch that can affect Windows x86. Runtime validation of the reported optimized-call stack-growth symptom remains outstanding.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp source-generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing interop paths. This corrects a potential Windows x86 ABI mismatch; runtime validation of the reported stack-growth symptom remains outstanding.
